items.title: Google publishes safety write-up for Gemini 4 Argon
items.summary_en: Google's post on developing Gemini 4 Argon responsibly describes the model's cyberdefense capabilities as frontier-level and aimed at helping defenders. It reports that on a prompt-injection benchmark, attack success fell to 0.7% across 15 adaptive attempts.
items.notes: Not fetched (DNS); search snippets only. Verify before use.

items.title: DeepMind and Google Cloud offer European researchers frontier science models and compute
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud say they will give up to 200 European researchers access to DeepMind's frontier science models. The offer includes $3 million in compute credits.
items.notes: Search snippet only; date and figures need verification.

items.title: On-device scam detection with Singapore's MDDI built on Gemma
items.summary_en: DeepMind and Singapore's Ministry of Digital Development and Information describe a Gemma model fine-tuned on local scam conversations. It is designed to run on-device so private chats stay private.
items.notes: Search snippet only; date needs verification.

items.title: Google Antigravity used to speed antimicrobial peptide search
items.summary_en: A DeepMind case study describes using Google Antigravity as an agentic workbench to find and validate new antimicrobial peptides.
items.notes: Search snippet only; date needs verification.

items.title: Global 10-meter forest-type map classifies natural, planted and farmed forests
items.summary_en: DeepMind published a global map at 10-meter resolution that classifies forests as natural, planted, or farmed. It includes a time series from 2017 to 2025.
items.notes: Search snippet only; date needs verification.
